reference_comparison: The approved porch/cabin/palm/creek composition and warm-cabin/cool-forest relationship remain recognizable. The covers lift brightness, saturation and cabin light relative to the darker video; close-up versions emphasize the cabin and crop the foreground shelter. Generative editing changes some fine foliage, water and architectural details, so these are cover illustrations rather than untouched frame exports.

recommendation.8h: B for emphasis on the cabin and an explicit dark-screen label
